description: This two-level pie chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across three primary categories and nine subcategories. The inner ring consists of three primary categories labeled directly inside the segments with rotated white text: "Contradiction Resolution" (brown), "Context Tracking" (dark blue), and "Context Retrieving" (dark green). The outer ring contains nine subcategories, each visually grouped adjacent to its corresponding primary category. Adjacent to "Contradiction Resolution" are three slices: "Prioritization" (light red) with a value of 100, "Personalization" (orange-red) at 100, and "Privacy Protection" (bright red) at 111. Adjacent to "Context Tracking" are "Triggering" (light blue) at 100, "Recursive Reasoning" (bright blue) at 110, and "Dynamic Environment" (medium blue) at 100. Adjacent to "Context Retrieving" are "Memorization" (light cyan) at 100, "Dynamic Instruction" (turquoise) at 100, and "Multitasking" (teal), which is the largest outer slice with a value of 160. There is no separate legend; instead, the outer subcategories are identified by text labels and numerical values connected to their respective slices by thin blue lines. The chart features a hollow center and white borders separating all segments, with no slices visually exploded or offset, and the segments are ordered by their primary category groupings rather than by descending or ascending size.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of 1.1K tasks across three primary categories and nine subcategories, with balanced sample sizes across capabilities. The central categories include 'Context Retrieving' (dark green), 'Context Tracking' (dark blue), and 'Contradiction Resolution' (dark red). Among the subcategories, 'Multitasking' has the highest value at 180, followed by 'Privacy Protection' at 121. Notably, 'Recursive Reasoning' demonstrates a consistent upward trend in its value compared to other subcategories. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative importance of each capability, with 'Dynamic Instruction' and 'Memorization' showing the lowest values at 90 each, indicating their lesser emphasis in the dataset.
